name: C&S Paper Co.,Ltd
summary: C&S Paper Co.,Ltd, established in 1979 and headquartered in Zhongshan, China, operates as a manufacturer and seller of household paper goods throughout Mainland China. Its primary product line features an extensive selection of items such as paper rolls, facial tissues, coreless rolls, tissue handkerchiefs, wipes, personal care products, baby diapers, and cotton tissues. The company has also diversified its offerings to include medical devices, disposable medical products, disinfectants, and medical face masks. Furthermore, its business scope extends to general merchandise, kitchenware, sanitary ware, daily sundries, non-woven fabrics and their products, polymer materials and their products, wood pulp, and various baby products, in addition to providing warehousing services. C&S, Sun, and Dolemi are the brands under which its products are sold.
